findings.text: the evidence_inputs line claims recovery.py carries 9 pre-existing findings, but the pinned ruff 0.16.4 reports 8 at both 311bfc62 and 299dac8a, so the number a reader would re-run does not reproduce even though the load-bearing zero delta does.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 311bfc62; 40102f8b adds the attempt-clock helper, the quiet-time cap and four cases, and 299dac8a appends the landing record, the evidence section and one XML-valid figure, with nothing outside the five fenced paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's four cases are the four tests in tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py (fresh attempt, stale attempt, no attempt clock, attempt-record fallback), the declared negative control is recorded in the run's negative-control.log, and the no-added-failures half is recorded in base-arm.log and after-suite.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks the stall verdict to read quiet time from the later of the last stream record and the current attempt's start; reckon/crew/recovery.py:2856 caps quiet time at now minus the attempt start, which is that same value, and reckon/crew/recovery.py:2812 reads the pointer field a resume writes at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:7025.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 112 passed at base and at head, 116 at the gate, the declared red control, and consumers unchanged, but its lint claim of 9 pre-existing findings in recovery.py does not reproduce (see the FINDING below).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the five fenced paths are named in the reviewed run's prompt; both commits' files (reckon/crew/recovery.py, the new test module, the landed evidence page, one figure under docs/figures/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner and the plan page) all sit inside them.

justifications.durability: deleting the cap at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2857-2858 makes tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py:128 read 1919 instead of 30, which is exactly what negative-control.log shows, and no added assertion compares a value against the input the test itself supplied.
justifications.evidence: the four done_when cases are asserted at tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py:104-176, gate.log records 116 passed at 40102f8b, base-arm.log records 112 passed at 311bfc62 in a scratch tree naming its module and cwd, and negative-control.log reddens the resumed case at 1919 against the injected 30.
justifications.fit: _attempt_started_seconds at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2803 mirrors the fall-back-to-record idiom of _run_stream_mtime at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2783, and the local ATTEMPT_RECORD_NAME at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2800 avoids a module cycle because reckon/crew/dispatch.py imports recovery.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:2856 computes min(stream silence, now minus attempt start), which is now minus max(last stream record, attempt start), and the live pointer of r-20260925T140712076451-lane-readers-share-the-gate-aware-headroom carries attempt 2 at 15:13:20Z, six seconds before the recorded false stall.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in 40102f8b and 299dac8a lies inside the five fenced paths, the plan-version and plan-modified meta lines are untouched, and the out-of-scope unwritten verdict is reported under follow_ons rather than changed.
